per_name.name: amide synthetase
per_name.note: states the target function; 26 entries, all PF00501+PF13193 ANL

per_name.name: amide bond synthetase
per_name.note: the engineered-biocatalysis name for acid + amine coupling

per_name.name: amide synthase
per_name.note: the -synthase spelling of the same function

per_name.name: amide ligase
per_name.note: the -ligase spelling of the same function

per_name.name: acid--amine ligase
per_name.note: EC 6.3.1.- systematic name; YgiC/YjfC ATP-grasp amide synthetases

per_name.name: carboxylate--amine ligase
per_name.note: EC 6.3.1.- systematic name for carboxylate + amine -> amide

per_name.name: beta-lactam synthetase
per_name.note: intramolecular amide closure by an ANL-family adenylating enzyme

per_name.name: amino acid ligase
per_name.note: dipeptide from two free amino acids; subsumes the L- and D- spellings

per_name.name: alanine-anticapsin ligase
per_name.note: BacD, the bacilysin dipeptide ligase; EC 6.3.2.28 had 0 of 11

per_name.name: poly-gamma-glutamate synthase
per_name.note: makes a genuine POLYAMIDE, poly-gamma-glutamate, and the table held 0 of 803 - a family absent rather than merely undersampled

rejected_names.name: N-acyltransferase
rejected_names.reason: a superfamily label, not a function: spans acetyl-, succinyl-, myristoyl- and every other acyl donor

rejected_names.name: peptide synthetase
rejected_names.reason: NRPS modules; the amide is formed on a carrier-bound thioester, not between two free monomers, and the screen rejects that chemistry

rejected_names.name: aminoacyltransferase
rejected_names.reason: aminoacyl-tRNA and ribosomal machinery; acceptor is not a free amine

rejected_names.name: glutamine synthetase
rejected_names.reason: forms a TERMINAL amide from ammonia. The substrate screen scores this 0.0 because a terminal amide cannot polycondense. Genuine members are already present via the EC route where a reaction maps to them

rejected_names.name: cyanophycin synthetase
rejected_names.reason: on-chemistry and the closest biological nylon analogue, but CphA is ALREADY captured by activity_ec and family_homolog. Adding ~3,800 near-identical orthologs would inflate the candidate count without adding one new family

rejected_names.name: tubulin--tyrosine ligase
rejected_names.reason: the acceptor is tubulin, a PROTEIN; the polymer/protein screen refuses macromolecular acceptors, and it exceeds the sanity ceiling anyway

rejected_names.name: glutathionylspermidine synthase
rejected_names.reason: on-chemistry - a polyamine acceptor, the closest thing to HMDA - but PF03738 is already a validated enriched family, so this would add ~5,800 orthologs of a family we have. Same test as cyanophycin

rejected_names.name: carnosine synthase
rejected_names.reason: on-chemistry (beta-Ala + His) but already 296 of 552 covered; the family is not the gap
